g.text: 2 · Cylinder life cycle (what the server allows)
3 · One save, end to end (driver taps Done on "Give")
How the cylinder app works today, end to end, and where it should go next. Six sections, top to bottom.
WEB APP (React + Vite) · one app, two faces
SIMPLE MODE · Hindi / English · pictures, dots, voice
5-second UNDO · big tick / cross · scan, photo or type
drivers: Give, Take back, My truck · godown: Came back, Load, Filled
40+ forms · Life story · QR download / print · More menus
act(): every save gets a retry key + CSRF token
(never saves twice, even on bad network)
SERVER (Express) · the only door to data
every safety + money rule lives here
Not built yet: WhatsApp · SMS · Tally · GST e-invoice · RFID · GPS
The server refuses an arrow that
breaks a rule: unsafe gas, test date
Each arrow adds a movement record:
No network? Deliveries are saved encrypted on the phone
and sent later with the ☁ button (same retry key).
UNDO in time → nothing reaches the server,
nothing in the audit log. A true "never happened".
Refused? One of 4 picture screens: no network,
something changed, not allowed, call office.
Simple only: Give · Take back · My truck · Scan · Problem
Simple first: Came back · Load truck · Filled · Scan · Problem → can switch to Office
Office first (inspect, release, recall, Safety) → Simple: Scan · Check
Office: everything, team, settings, audit → can switch to Simple
Office: Billing & rentals, customers, invoices, receipts, deposits, credits
The server decides what each role
receives and may do. Hiding a
Run it like a product: staging + production · error alerts · uptime checks · daily backups with point-in-time restore · tests on every push
Native Android / iOS app + thermal print
OURS ONLY: Hindi + English picture mode for workers who cannot read · Sarvam voice · 5-second undo · plain-language Life story · read QR from a photo · server-enforced safety rules
